questions.prompt: In a single-raised pot the preflop raiser…

choices.text: Has the initiative and more strong hands on high dry boards.
Has a capped range like a limper

questions.explanation: The open is the aggressor’s advantage. Use it on boards that fit the raising range.

choices.text: Check to the raiser, continue with pairs and draws, and fold air.

questions.explanation: The caller realizes equity by checking and choosing, not by leading weak hands.

choices.text: Bet dry boards small and check back boards that favor the caller.
Only bet when out of position
Use one size on every texture

questions.explanation: Position plus the initiative is the single-raised advantage.

questions.prompt: Delayed lines belong in single-raised pots when…

choices.text: The flop was checked and the turn helps the player who bets later.
The board is already the nuts for everyone

questions.explanation: A missed flop c-bet can become a turn bet. That is a single-raised pattern, not a limped one.
